facts.text: I am looking to get a quote from Progressive for my car insurance.
I have been with Geico for 3 years.
I washed my car today using a new car wash soap.
The new car wash soap removed bug splatters on the front bumper.
I want a rundown of the different coverage options Progressive offers.
I specifically want Progressive comprehensive and collision coverage information.
I didn't know Progressive had loan/lease gap coverage.
I think loan/lease gap coverage sounds like a great feature to have.
I asked whether Progressive offers discounts for safe drivers or multi-car policies.
I think I will definitely consider adding loan/lease gap coverage to my policy.
I asked whether Progressive offers discounts for car safety features.
I have a silver Honda Civic.
My silver Honda Civic has lane departure warning.
My silver Honda Civic has blind spot detection.
I asked whether I would be eligible for discounts for lane departure warning and blind spot detection.
I plan to mention my car safety features when I get a quote.
I was thinking of getting a steering wheel cover to protect my wheel from the sun's UV rays.
I asked whether Progressive offers discounts for interior protection or accessories like a steering wheel cover.
I am thinking of getting a quote from State Farm as well.
I asked whether State Farm offers similar discounts or features to Progressive.

events.text: Washed the car using a new car wash soap and removed bug splatters on the front bumper
